Sam (Sales): FYI warm handoff for Auriga Health — signed yesterday, 3-seat pilot, wants private VPC and SSO. Go-live target: 2024-11-15. :wave:
Miranda (CS): Thanks Sam. Adding CS owners and checklist. Who's the billing contact and who's leading infra on their side?
Sam (Sales): Billing is +Maya (m.maya@auriga.com). Infra lead is Marco (cc'd in the contract). I'll DM the contact details.
Miranda (CS): Good. High-level risks: SSO + cert exchange, private deploy windows (ops freeze), and early token usage could spike. I'll schedule an enablement kickoff for next Wed.
Rosa (Solutions): Need sample redirect URI and OIDC metadata from Auriga. Also confirm whether they want dedicated GPU pool vs shared private. If dedicated, we need capacity estimate.
Sam (Sales): They've asked for dedicated to avoid noisy neighbors. Estimated 2 GPUs for pilot, maybe 4 at scale.
Ken (Support): Thanks — I'll own the support/eng intake. Please open a triage ticket with: expected qps, model family, seq len, and sample payloads. Tag as P2 for go-live readiness.
Miranda (CS): Created ticket: INF-2341. handoff-bot: "Ticket INF-2341 created by Miranda (CS) — Onboarding: Auriga Health — owners: Miranda, Ken, Rosa"
handoff-bot: "Linked sales contract: https://redwood.app/contr/auriga-002 (read-only)"
Miranda (CS): Next steps I propose: 1) Sales add final contacts to the ticket (done) 2) Solutions (Rosa) to confirm SSO flow + required URIs by EOD Tue 3) Support (Ken) to run capacity/latency acceptance plan and share runbook 4) CS to run enablement + prompt library capture 5) Weekly sync until go-live.
Ken (Support): I'll draft a quick acceptance checklist. Need the following from Auriga: a) SSO test tenant b) sample requests (150 token avg) c) expected concurrent sessions.
Sam (Sales): I'll push for the test tenant and sample requests today.
Miranda (CS): Also flagging renewal risk: contract auto-renews at month 11 if quality ok. We should capture early CS metrics (latency, cost per 1k tokens, error rate) and share at week 4.
Rosa (Solutions): Quick config snippet I asked them to provide (example):
```
redirect_uris:
  - https://dev.auriga.com/auth/callback
  - https://uat.auriga.com/auth/callback
client_id: <provided by auriga>
```
Miranda (CS): Owners and channels: Miranda = primary CS, Ken = support/eng escalation, Rosa = solutions/config, Sam = sales follow-up. I'll set a calendar invite for the kickoff and add INF-2341 to it.
Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll update contract notes and ping Marco for infra details.
Ken (Support): Adding a note for eng: if they require dedicated GPUs, please plan a short capacity smoke test (5m spike, 100 concurrent) before any production cutover.
Miranda (CS): Closing loop — please update INF-2341 with any artifacts. If anything blocks by Friday EOD, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
